Problem: Pi Pi Lu wrote a 2020-digit number: \( 5368 \cdots \cdots \). If any four-digit number taken randomly from this multi-digit number is divisible by 11, what is the sum of the digits of this multi-digit number?

<reflection>
The number has 2020 digits and starts with the prefix 5368... The goal is to find the sum of the digits of this 2020-digit number. The original condition is that any four-digit number taken from this multi-digit number is divisible by 11.
This misinterprets the original condition: the intended meaning is that every consecutive four-digit block/substring is divisible by 11, not that any four digits can be selected and arranged arbitrarily.
Treat the condition as every consecutive four-digit substring being divisible by 11, then apply the divisibility rule for 11 to adjacent four-digit substrings to find the period of the digits.
</reflection>
